quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hungarian paprika isn't just one spice — there are eight official grades ranging from delicate and sweet to fiery hot! The town of Szeged is so famous for paprika that it has its own paprika museum and an annual paprika festival every October.

short_read.title: How Hummingbirds Navigate Thousands of Miles
short_read.teaser: These tiny birds, weighing less than a nickel, can remember every flower they've visited and return to the same gardens year after year. Scientists are discovering their remarkable navigation abilities involve stars, sun, and even Earth's magnetic field.

medium_read.title: The Enchanted Valley: Crown Jewel of Olympic National Park
medium_read.teaser: Deep in the heart of Olympic National Park lies a pristine valley so beautiful it earned the name 'Valley of 10,000 Waterfalls.' This remote paradise showcases the lush rainforest ecosystem that makes the Olympic Peninsula so special.

long_read.title: The Secret Gardeners of Wartime Britain
long_read.teaser: During World War II, ordinary British citizens transformed their flower gardens into vegetable plots in a campaign called 'Dig for Victory.' This heartwarming story reveals how community gardens not only fed a nation but lifted spirits during the darkest days of war.

port_angeles.title: Harbor Seal Pupping Season Ends
port_angeles.description: Late August marks the end of harbor seal pupping season in the Strait of Juan de Fuca. The adorable pups born this summer are now learning to fish on their own and can often be spotted lounging on the rocks near Ediz Hook, their spotted coats glistening in the sun.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute while hovering.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Exactly right! That's an incredibly fast heartbeat — about 20 beats every second!
puzzle_1.close_response: Very close! A hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute while hovering — that's amazingly fast!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: It's hard to imagine, but a hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute! That tiny heart works incredibly hard.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: To power their energy-intensive hovering flight, hummingbirds have the fastest heart rate of all birds. At rest, their heart rate drops to about 250 beats per minute, and they enter a hibernation-like state called torpor to conserve energy at night.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful! 'Pillangó' is such a lovely, lyrical word for these delicate creatures!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The Hungarian word for butterfly is 'pillangó' — doesn't it sound as graceful as a butterfly's flight? (Madár means bird, virág means flower, and napraforgó means sunflower.)
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: Hungarian is a unique language unrelated to most European languages — it's part of the Finno-Ugric family. Many Hungarian words are beautifully descriptive, like 'pillangó,' which may come from an old word meaning 'to flutter.'

puzzle_3.question: What do gardeners call the practice of planting different crops in the same space across seasons?
puzzle_3.correct_response: Perfect! Crop rotation is an ancient practice that keeps soil healthy and helps prevent pests. Farmers have used this wisdom for thousands of years!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: The answer is crop rotation — changing what you plant in each spot each season. This smart practice helps soil stay nutritious and naturally reduces pests without chemicals!
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Crop rotation has been practiced since ancient Roman times. Different plants use and replenish different nutrients, so rotating crops like beans (which add nitrogen) with tomatoes (which need nitrogen) keeps gardens thriving naturally.
